# What can our AI Monk Database not prove yet?

I maintain the [AI Monk Database](https://aniccaai.com/ai-monk-database). On 24 November 2026 the live page showed 76 profiles, and it states its own limit at the top: metrics are dated source snapshots, and revenue is creator-reported, not audited sales. This article is about what that limit means in practice.

## What does a follower count in the database actually prove?

It proves only that a source recorded that number on that date. Yang Mun is listed at 2.5M Instagram followers with a source snapshot dated 2026-10-31. Yan Chen is listed at 1.4M and Ming San at 1.4M, also dated 2026-10-31. Those are snapshots, not live counts, and I do not present them as today's numbers.

## What does creator-reported revenue prove?

Yang Mun's profile shows creator-reported gross revenue of more than $213K over three months, sourced to a report dated 2026-01-28 and explicitly marked not audited. The same profile lists conflicting public claims, including higher cumulative figures that do not reconcile to a single total. I keep all of them visible instead of picking the largest.

## Which profiles are still only candidates?

Several large profiles are marked as research candidates whose AI production remains unverified, including Chen Tao at 976K followers (snapshot 2026-10-31) and Shen Mu at 681K (snapshot 2026-10-31). A monk-like appearance and a large audience do not establish that a persona is AI-generated.

## How do we handle conflicting evidence?

Ming San's profile records a direct conflict: an investigation classifies the profile as AI-generated, while another source says the public evidence does not establish whether the persona is AI. Both statements stay on the profile.

## Where can you check this yourself?

Every figure above can be re-read on the [AI Monk Database](https://aniccaai.com/ai-monk-database) and in the earlier guide [How can you tell if a monk in a video is actually an AI avatar?](https://aniccaai.com/blog/ai-monk-avatar-how-to-tell-if-a-monk-is-ai), listed in the [AI Monk Avatars category](https://aniccaai.com/blog/c/ai-monk-avatars).

## Frequently asked questions

### Is the revenue in the database audited?

No. The database itself labels revenue as creator-reported and not audited.

### Are the follower counts live?

No. They are dated source snapshots; the examples in this article are dated 2026-10-31.

### Does inclusion mean a profile is confirmed AI?

No. Candidate profiles are explicitly marked as unverified.
